list_keywords.title: List keywords
list_keywords.description: List the keyword rules configured on a page's bot: each rule's id, the phrases it listens for and the flow it triggers. Use it to find a keyword_id before update_keyword.

page_id.description: Id of the Facebook page (or channel) the Botcake bot is connected to. The access token is issued per page, so this is the page the token belongs to.

data.description: Keyword rules, each with an id.

create_keyword.title: Create a keyword
create_keyword.description: Create a keyword rule on a page's bot, so that an incoming message matching it triggers a flow. Botcake's reference site is currently offline, so the body is passed through as given rather than field by field.
create_keyword.notes: The published reference (docs.botcake.io) could not be read when this pack was written; the body shape is the caller's to supply.

page_id.description: Id of the Facebook page (or channel) the Botcake bot is connected to. The access token is issued per page, so this is the page the token belongs to.

keyword.description: The keyword rule to create, in Botcake's own shape; list_keywords shows the fields an existing rule carries.

update_keyword.title: Update a keyword
update_keyword.description: Change an existing keyword rule, most usefully to point it at a different flow. `update` holds the fields to change, e.g. {flow_id: 123}.

page_id.description: Id of the Facebook page (or channel) the Botcake bot is connected to. The access token is issued per page, so this is the page the token belongs to.

keyword_id.description: Id of the keyword rule to change, from list_keywords.

update.description: Fields to change on the rule, e.g. {flow_id: 123} with a flow id from list_flows.

list_flows.title: List flows
list_flows.description: List the flows built on a page's bot, each with its id and name. A flow is a scripted conversation; its id is what a keyword rule points at.

page_id.description: Id of the Facebook page (or channel) the Botcake bot is connected to. The access token is issued per page, so this is the page the token belongs to.

data.description: Holds flows: an array of {id, name}.

list_tools.title: List tools
list_tools.description: List the tools set up on a page's bot, such as its growth tools and automation entry points, with their ids and configuration.

page_id.description: Id of the Facebook page (or channel) the Botcake bot is connected to. The access token is issued per page, so this is the page the token belongs to.

data.description: The tools configured on the page.
